meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (concept layout of study D's recommended heel drive; CALC masses from volumes and catalogue; ASSUMPTION dimensions; nothing built or measured)
meta.concept: steered and driven wheel at the heel (powered cobot); modes: steer only (passive guidance, tremor constraint), steer + brake, steer + drive (lead-through, autowrite)
meta.replaces_note: skid_ring -> drive_skid_ring (contact radius 8.40 mm instead of 6.75 mm, slotted); front_sleeve grows at the front from 15.0 to 18.3 mm (same 22 mm at z 50); optical -> drive_paper_sensor (no longer optional: slip detection); the board magnet and its keel give way to the shaft keel (the heel drive does the board's job without a board)

changes_to_other_revH_parts.refill_spring: the refill slides 15.5 mm over 35-75 deg instead of 13.5 mm

meta.added_mass_note: parts listed here; the larger front sleeve adds about 2.5 g more (CALC, PEEK/TPE 1.3 g/cm3)
meta.tilted_parts_note: drive_wheel, drive_fork and drive_pod lie on the paper normal (50 deg to the pen axis); here they are axis-aligned stand-ins; mechanics/cad/heel_drive.py draws them tilted

axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x in the tilt plane, positive away from the paper; y transverse

components.label: Skid ring with wheel slot
components.function: Rests on the paper like the Rev H ring, but larger, with a slot at the bottom through which the drive wheel reaches the paper.
components.part: custom (PTFE-coated POM, contact radius 8.40 mm, open 120 deg on top)

components.label: Drive wheel with O-ring tyre
components.function: A 2 mm wheel that rolls on the paper: steered, it lets the pen move only along the letter; driven, it pushes the pen along it.
components.part: custom brass hub d 0.8 mm + NBR O-ring 0.8 x 0.6 mm (tyre); axle d 0.3 mm in jewel bearings

components.label: Steering fork and crown
components.function: Holds the wheel and turns it about the paper normal through its contact point; carries the crown gear, the axle bevel and a tiny magnet for the steering-angle sensor.
components.part: custom (hardened steel fork, brass crown gear module 0.1, bevel 2:1 to the axle)

components.label: Heel pod (sprung)
components.function: Bearing block for the fork, the two bevel pinions and the sensors; it hangs on a flexure so a 0.55 N preload presses the wheel onto the paper.

components.label: Preload flexure
components.function: Leaf spring that lets the pod move 0.54 mm toward the paper and presses it with about 0.55 N; the ring takes any extra writing force.

components.label: Wheel-load sensor
components.function: Hall sensor that reads the flexure's bend: the wheel's load, which sets how much force can be used before the wheel slips.
components.part: linear Hall IC (DRV5055 class) + 1 mm magnet

components.label: Steering-angle sensor
components.function: Reads the wheel's heading from a magnet on the fork, right at the wheel (so shaft twist does not matter).
components.part: 3-D Hall IC (TMAG5273 class) + diametric magnet d 1 mm

components.label: Drive shaft
components.function: Thin steel shaft in a PTFE liner that carries the drive motor's turning to the heel pod.
components.part: custom (stainless shaft d 0.8 mm, PTFE liner d 1.2 mm; 40 deg bevel pinion at the pod)

components.label: Steering shaft
components.function: Thin steel shaft in a PTFE liner that carries the steering motor's turning to the heel pod.
components.part: custom (stainless shaft d 0.8 mm, PTFE liner d 1.2 mm; 40 deg bevel pinion at the pod)

components.label: Shaft keel
components.function: Ridge under the front sleeve (toward the paper) that houses the two shafts either side of the paper sensor.
components.part: PEEK / TPE, part of the sleeve moulding

components.label: Paper sensor (needed by the drive)
components.function: Optical sensor that sees the paper: it detects wheel slip (pen motion that the wheel did not make) and gives the page position.
components.part: optical flow sensor, to select (mouse-class performance as PMW3360: 1 kHz reports, 12 000 frames/s; its own package is too large)

components.label: Transfer gears
components.function: Two small spur-gear pairs that move each motor's output out to its shaft, around the gimbal.
components.part: module 0.1 spur gears (33 teeth, 1:1, centre distance 3.3 mm), brass

components.label: Wheel drive motor
components.function: Turns the wheel so the pen is pushed along the letter (up to about 0.5 N at the wheel).
components.part: Faulhaber 0620 B brushless DC, 6 x 20 mm (drive: bevel 2:1 at the wheel; steering: crown 2:1)

components.label: Steering motor
components.function: Turns the wheel's heading to follow the letter.
components.part: Faulhaber 0620 B brushless DC, 6 x 20 mm (drive: bevel 2:1 at the wheel; steering: crown 2:1)

components.label: Motor drivers
components.function: Two three-phase drivers with current sensing that set each motor's torque 2000 times a second.
components.part: 3-phase micro BLDC driver x2 (to select; DRV8311 class)
